=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5796-5797 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The warning-count assertion includes a pre-existing unauthenticated-report WARNING emitted because the test fixture has no report_identity, so it counts two warnings instead of one.
  WHY: The fixture reaches the provenance warning before non-retryable routing; reviewers classify this as a test-fixture/assertion defect, not a routing defect.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5863 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test’s `len(warnings) == 1` assertion counts an additional Telegram warning and fails.
  WHY: The test suite fails because its expected warning count does not account for the warning generated before routing.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5826 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-report test asserts that `tg.log` does not exist, but the fixture’s missing report_identity causes an earlier unauthenticated-report WARNING to create it.
  WHY: The duplicate branch itself sends no warning; the assertion fails on the pre-existing provenance warning.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5892 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-report test expects no Telegram log, but an earlier warning creates `tg.log`.
  WHY: The test suite fails because the assertion does not account for the warning generated before duplicate handling.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:419, 532-547 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The unauthenticated-report WARNING is sent before the duplicate-diagnosis check, so a duplicate with no OIDC identity still sends a warning despite the documented “sends no alert” behavior.
  WHY: With `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REQUIRE_REPORT_AUTH=false`, the intake emits the warning before the duplicate branch exits; this also contaminates the test assertions.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2969-2989 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Non-retryable label-event suppression does not bind the trusted diagnosis marker to the PR’s current head or end suppression on a trusted editor success summary.
  WHY: An old diagnosis can remain the newest trusted failure-or-diagnosis comment and cause a later unrelated escalation to be silently skipped.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:538-547 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If `BIND_PULL_FILE` is missing or lacks a parseable labels array, the duplicate-label branch reports `label=present` without verifying the label or attempting recovery.
  WHY: A prior diagnosis comment can succeed while the label write fails, leaving subsequent reports unable to retry adding `ai:needs-human`.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5866 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment-post-failure test’s generic WARNING assertion can pass because of the unrelated unauthenticated-report WARNING rather than the intended diagnosis-failure alert.
  WHY: The test would not detect removal of the “could not post the non-retryable diagnosis” alert.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
